title: Runtime fallback scripting cookbook — seller draft
summary: Compact field-facing playbook that gives seller/SEs a set of short, copy-pasteable fallback scripts, one-liners, and architecture notes to close deals quickly when customers raise operational/availability questions about model/region failures.
audience: Sales Engineers, Field Sellers, Solutions Engineers, Technical AEs
objectives: 1) Equip sellers with deterministic, low-risk fallback language and config examples they can propose on calls. 2) Reduce back-and-forth with customers by giving clear scripts and rollout suggestions. 3) Highlight tradeoffs and callouts (latency, cost, quality).
slides_outline: Title + TL;DR: Fallbacks as a sales asset
When to propose a fallback (signals from customers)
key_rebuttals: If they worry about correctness: suggest canary with 5% traffic to higher-quality model + metric gating
If they worry about cost: explain burst routing to cheaper variants with KV cache preservation
If they worry about latency: propose region-based routing + smaller context windows during fallback
If they worry about coherence: recommend structured prompt wrappers and automatic post-filtering on fallback responses
quick_snippets: Routing policy (pseudo): route->if(region.latency>120ms) then target: model-lite-v2 else target: main-model-v1
Canary rollout: set traffic_split = { main-model-v1: 95, fast-quantized-v2: 5 } and monitor response_time, token_cost, hallucination_rate
Simple redirect for private deployments: env var REDWOOD_FALLBACK_MODE=region-first ; restart agent
play_examples: Large retailer pilot: when eu-west3 saturated, how we routed 30% traffic to quantized variant and preserved prefix cache -> outcome: no customer-visible outage, +18% cost reduction during peak
Fintech integration: customer wanted deterministic 99th p95 SLA; we proposed dual-region routing + active health probes -> outcome: SLO met with minor cost delta and signed PO for Dedicated
customer_ready_copy: Email snippet: 'We can avoid extended downtime by routing a small percentage of traffic to a lower-latency variant while we scale your dedicated pool. Below is the exact config our engineers will deploy:'
Call script: 'If latency spikes, we'll enable our pre-tested fallback which keeps conversational context but reduces per-token compute by ~35% — customers keep UI continuity.'
tradeoffs_note: Fallbacks are pragmatic but not free: quantized/cheaper variants reduce cost/latency at some quality risk. Recommend pairing fallbacks with active monitoring and short-lived policy windows (minutes to hours), not permanent defaults.
handoff_checklist: Capture the customer's acceptance criteria (latency/quality thresholds)
Agree rollback criteria and metric dashboards
Document the exact traffic split and TTL for fallback window
Set an owner for 24–48h watch & escalation path
next_steps: 1) Field test this deck with two AE/SE pairs this quarter. 2) Collect three customer snippets and measurable outcomes to convert into a one-pager. 3) Add two copy-paste API examples to the public seller snippets repo (GH #283).
notes_to_self: Keep examples short and operational. Avoid deep runtime internals; focus on what a customer-facing engineer can propose and what ops will expect. Follow up with runtime team to validate the exact header names and env vars before finalizing.
